pmgsy_habitations.label: Rural habitations (PMGSY 2024)
pmgsy_habitations.description: Point locations of rural habitations registered under PMGSY. Finer than village polygons; finer than the LGD village hierarchy.

wris_lakes.label: Lakes (WRIS 2024)
wris_lakes.description: Lake polygons across India from the Central Water Commission Water Resources Information System.

wris_watersheds.label: Watersheds (WRIS 2024)
wris_watersheds.description: Watershed boundary polygons from CWC WRIS: the tier below sub-basin in the hydrology hierarchy.

wris_river_polygons.label: River polygons (WRIS 2024)
wris_river_polygons.description: Rivers as polygon geometry from CWC WRIS: complements the existing line-geometry river network for area-based queries.

slusi_soil_health.label: Soil health (SLUSI 2020-23 snapshot)
slusi_soil_health.description: Soil health cards / soil-suitability polygons across India from SLUSI. Vintage snapshot; the upstream refresh cadence is multi-year.

wris_waterbodies.label: Waterbodies (WRIS 2024)
wris_waterbodies.description: Surface waterbody polygons from CWC WRIS: covers ponds, tanks, reservoirs and natural waterbodies beyond named lakes.

slusi_micro_watersheds.label: Micro-watersheds (SLUSI)
slusi_micro_watersheds.description: Micro-watershed boundary polygons across India from the Soil and Land Use Survey of India: the finest watershed delineation in the hydrology hierarchy.

pmgsy_roads.label: Rural roads (PMGSY 2024)
pmgsy_roads.description: Pan-India rural road network built or in progress under PMGSY-I/II/III. Complements national highways.

ndem_floods_1998_2022.label: Flood inundation 1998-2022 (NDEM)
ndem_floods_1998_2022.description: Pan-India satellite-derived flood inundation polygons from 1998 to 2022, compiled by NDEM (NRSC/ISRO). Complements the older India Flood Inventory v3 event catalogue.

gsi_landslide_inventory.label: Landslide inventory (GSI)
gsi_landslide_inventory.description: Geological Survey of India landslide inventory: pan-India catalogue of historical landslide occurrences with metadata.

ndem_landslide_hazard.label: Landslide hazard zones (NDEM)
ndem_landslide_hazard.description: Landslide hazard zonation polygons across India from NDEM, classifying terrain by landslide susceptibility.

ngdr_earthquakes.label: Earthquake epicentres (NGDR)
ngdr_earthquakes.description: Historical earthquake epicentre points across India from the National Geoscience Data Repository (GSI Bhukosh). Complements the BIS IS 1893:2016 seismic hazard zones we already host.

ndem_cyclone_tracks.label: Cyclone tracks (NDEM)
ndem_cyclone_tracks.description: Historical cyclone track line geometries across the Indian Ocean basins, compiled by NDEM.

overture_places_india.label: Places (Overture Maps, Nov 2026)
overture_places_india.description: Pan-India points of interest from the Overture Maps Foundation release 2026-11-18.0. Names, categories (basic_category, taxonomy), addresses, websites, brands and confidence scores for shops, restaurants, ATMs, schools, hospitals, transit, monuments and more.

cgwb_aquifers.label: Aquifers (CGWB)
cgwb_aquifers.description: Principal aquifer systems of India from the Central Ground Water Board, classified by rock type, age, yield and depth to water.

cgwb_gw_extraction.label: Groundwater Extraction (CGWB)
cgwb_gw_extraction.description: Block and taluk-level stage of groundwater extraction from the Central Ground Water Board (2020 assessment): Safe, Semi-Critical, Critical and Over-Exploited units with recharge and draft figures.

wris_canals.label: Canals (WRIS)
wris_canals.description: Irrigation canal network across India from the Central Water Commission Water Resources Information System, with command area, project and canal-type attributes.

agro_ecological_zones.label: Agro-Ecological Zones
agro_ecological_zones.description: India's 20 agro-ecological regions classified by ICAR-NBSS&LUP from physiography, soils, bioclimate and length of growing period.

agro_climatic_zones.label: Agro-Climatic Zones
agro_climatic_zones.description: India's 15 agro-climatic zones defined by the Planning Commission for agricultural planning, with temperature, rainfall, soil and major-crop attributes.

biogeographic_zones.label: Biogeographic Zones
biogeographic_zones.description: India's biogeographic classification (10 zones across 26 provinces) from the Wildlife Institute of India: Himalaya, Western Ghats, Deccan Peninsula, Desert, Gangetic Plain and more.

corestack_lulc_blocks.label: Land Use & Cropping Intensity by Block (2023-24)
corestack_lulc_blocks.description: Land use and cropping intensity per LGD block in 2023-24: single, double and triple cropping, seasonal and perennial water, trees, scrub, barren and built-up land. Modelled from CoRE Stack's 10 m IndiaSAT map, not official crop statistics. Islands are not mapped and the high Himalaya only partly; mapped_pct shows coverage.

mi6_wells_districts.label: Wells by District (Minor Irrigation Census 2017-18)
mi6_wells_districts.description: Wells per LGD district from the 6th Minor Irrigation Census (reference year 2017-18): dugwells and shallow, medium and deep tubewells, with status, pump energy source, depth and irrigation potential. Official census counts summed to districts.

sbm_wards.label: Urban wards, all India (SBM)
sbm_wards.description: Ward boundaries for about 3,300 towns and cities from Swachh Bharat Mission (Urban). Quality varies by town: some repeat wards or use an older delimitation, so where bharatlas has a city ward map, prefer it. No data for West Bengal, Tripura, Mizoram or Manipur.

sbm_ulbs.label: Towns and cities, all India (SBM)
sbm_ulbs.description: Boundaries of about 3,370 urban local bodies (municipal corporations, councils and nagar panchayats) from Swachh Bharat Mission (Urban). No data for Tripura, Mizoram or Manipur.

nhp_hospitals.label: Hospitals directory (NHP 2025)
nhp_hospitals.description: Hospitals listed in the National Health Portal directory, with category, care type, system of medicine, address and phone numbers. About 170 entries have coordinates outside India in the source.

nin_health_facilities.label: Health facilities (NIN 2025)
nin_health_facilities.description: Public health facilities registered with a National Identification Number (NIN): sub-centres, primary and community health centres and hospitals, with address and type.

udise_schools.label: Schools (UDISE)
udise_schools.description: About 2.9 million schools from UDISE (Ministry of Education) as mapped by NCOG: UDISE code, management, category, year established, enrolment, teachers, electricity and drinking water, with LGD state and district codes. About 920,000 schools have no state or district in the source; the shapefile has one file per state.

fsi_circles.label: Forest circles (FSI)
fsi_circles.description: Forest administrative circles from the Forest Survey of India, the level above divisions.

fsi_divisions.label: Forest divisions (FSI)
fsi_divisions.description: Forest divisions from the Forest Survey of India, with circle and state.

fsi_ranges.label: Forest ranges (FSI)
fsi_ranges.description: Forest ranges from the Forest Survey of India, with division, circle, district and LGD codes.

fsi_beats.label: Forest beats (FSI)
fsi_beats.description: Forest beats, the smallest unit of forest administration, from the Forest Survey of India, with reserved forest, compartment, range, division and LGD codes. Many name fields are blank in the source.

wildlife_corridors.label: Wildlife reserves and corridors (PARIVESH)
wildlife_corridors.description: Tiger reserves, wildlife corridors and other reserves from PARIVESH, the environment ministry clearance portal.

crz2019_zones.label: Coastal Regulation Zones 2019 (PARIVESH)
crz2019_zones.description: Coastal Regulation Zone areas (CRZ-I to CRZ-IV) under the CRZ Notification 2019, from approved Coastal Zone Management Plans. For reference; the approved state CZMP maps are the legal record. The source covers Maharashtra, Karnataka and Odisha only.

crz2019_lines.label: Coastal regulation lines 2019 (PARIVESH)
crz2019_lines.description: High tide, low tide, hazard and no-development lines under the CRZ Notification 2019. For reference; the approved state CZMP maps are the legal record. The source covers Maharashtra, Karnataka and Odisha only.

gw_quality_premonsoon.label: Groundwater quality, pre-monsoon (Bhuvan)
gw_quality_premonsoon.description: Pre-monsoon groundwater quality samples (pH, TDS, hardness, fluoride, nitrate, iron, arsenic and more, with a potability class) from Bhuvan. Columns vary by state and year in the source.

gw_quality_postmonsoon.label: Groundwater quality, post-monsoon (Bhuvan)
gw_quality_postmonsoon.description: Post-monsoon groundwater quality samples (pH, TDS, hardness, fluoride, nitrate, iron, arsenic and more, with a potability class) from Bhuvan. Columns vary by state and year in the source.

gsi_geology_2m.label: Geology 1:2M (GSI)
gsi_geology_2m.description: Geological map of India at 1:2 million: rock units with age, supergroup, group and stratigraphy, from the Geological Survey of India.

gsi_coal_blocks.label: Coal blocks (GSI)
gsi_coal_blocks.description: Coal blocks with coalfield, exploration status, resources and allotted company, from the Geological Survey of India.

gsi_critical_minerals.label: Critical mineral occurrences (GSI)
gsi_critical_minerals.description: Critical mineral localities (copper, rare earths, lithium and others) with commodity, resource, grade, host rock and age, from the Geological Survey of India.

gsi_lineaments_250k.label: Lineaments 1:250k (GSI)
gsi_lineaments_250k.description: Structural and geomorphic lineaments (faults, fractures, joints) mapped at 1:250,000 by the Geological Survey of India.

police_stations_ap.label: Police station areas, Andhra Pradesh (APSAC)
police_stations_ap.description: Police station jurisdictions in Andhra Pradesh with circle, sub-division, division, district and station phone number.

police_stations_bihar.label: Police station areas, Bihar (i-Bhugoal)
police_stations_bihar.description: Police thana jurisdictions in Bihar with district and thana code.

police_stations_delhi.label: Police station areas, Delhi (GSDL)
police_stations_delhi.description: Police station jurisdictions in Delhi with district, sub-division and range.

police_stations_tn.label: Police station areas, Tamil Nadu (TNGIS)
police_stations_tn.description: Law-and-order police station jurisdictions in Tamil Nadu with district and taluk.

traffic_police_stations_tn.label: Traffic police station areas, Tamil Nadu (TNGIS)
traffic_police_stations_tn.description: Traffic police station jurisdictions in Tamil Nadu with district and taluk.

police_stations_telangana.label: Police station areas, Telangana (TGRAC)
police_stations_telangana.description: Police station jurisdictions in Telangana with mandal, district, circle and sub-division.

marine_police_stations.label: Marine police station areas (NCOG)

amrit_sarovar_ponds.label: Amrit Sarovar ponds
amrit_sarovar_ponds.description: Ponds built or rejuvenated under Mission Amrit Sarovar (mostly via MGNREGA), with status, scheme, village, block and district.

zones_chennai.label: Chennai (GCC) Zones
zones_chennai.description: Greater Chennai Corporation: 15 zones, plus St. Thomas Mount as a 16th area, from Transparent Chennai via DataMeet.
zones_chennai.seo_description: Map of Greater Chennai Corporation's 15 zones (plus St. Thomas Mount). View zone boundaries; download as GeoJSON, KML or Parquet.

wb_amrut_wards.label: Urban wards, West Bengal (AMRUT)
wb_amrut_wards.description: Ward boundaries for 52 West Bengal towns and cities from the state AMRUT GIS, with ward number, town and district codes. Fills the West Bengal gap in the national SBM wards; Kolkata has its own ward map.

wb_amrut_ulbs.label: Towns and cities, West Bengal (AMRUT)
wb_amrut_ulbs.description: Boundaries of 57 West Bengal urban local bodies (municipal corporations, municipalities and development authorities) from the state AMRUT GIS. Kolkata is not included.

ir_stations.label: Railway stations
ir_stations.description: One point per Indian Railways station or halt, with its station code, merged by bharatlas from two government copies of the CRIS station layer (PM GatiShakti and the IR GIS portal) and Wikidata station codes, with a source and match-confidence column on every row.

ir_tracks.label: Railway tracks (Indian Railways GIS)
ir_tracks.description: Railway track segments from the Indian Railways GIS portal, with section, zone, division, chainage and state.

cadastrals_puducherry_coastal.label: Coastal land parcels, Puducherry (NCSCM)
cadastrals_puducherry_coastal.description: Survey-number land parcels in 39 coastal villages of Puducherry, Karaikal and Yanam from the coastal zone management plan maps, with the area of each parcel (square metres) inside each coastal regulation zone: CRZ-IA, IB, II, IVB, no-development zone, 200 to 500 m from the high tide line, hazard line and mangrove buffer. Coastal villages only; Mahe is not covered.

property_tax_chennai_wards.label: Chennai Property Tax by Ward (2013-18)
property_tax_chennai_wards.description: Property tax demand and collection in each of Chennai's 200 wards, residential and commercial, for 2013-14 to 2017-18, in rupees crore, from Greater Chennai Corporation via the Smart Cities Mission data portal.

wards_hyderabad_osm.label: Hyderabad Wards (OpenStreetMap, historical)
wards_hyderabad_osm.description: Greater Hyderabad Municipal Corporation wards as mapped in OpenStreetMap (2017-18): 144 of the 150 wards in 145 polygons, the map bharatlas showed before GHMC's own. Historical reference; use the GHMC 150-ward layer.
wards_hyderabad_osm.notes: Use the GHMC 150-ward layer for current ward boundaries.
wards_hyderabad_osm.seo_description: Earlier OpenStreetMap-derived map of 145 Hyderabad (GHMC) wards, kept for reference. View ward boundaries and names; download as GeoJSON, KML or Parquet.

cityfinance_ulb_balance_sheets.label: City Balance Sheets (CityFinance.in)
cityfinance_ulb_balance_sheets.description: Balance sheets of Indian cities (urban local bodies) from their annual accounts, as standardised by CityFinance.in (MoHUA): municipal fund and reserves, grants, loans, current liabilities, fixed assets, investments, receivables and cash, in rupees, on Swachh Bharat Mission ULB boundaries.

cadastrals_andaman_coastal.label: Coastal land parcels, Andaman and Nicobar (NCSCM)
cadastrals_andaman_coastal.description: Survey-number land parcels in the coastal villages of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands from the coastal zone management plan maps, with plot or survey number, village and island. Coastal villages only; column names vary between islands in the source.

cadastrals_goa.label: Land parcels, Goa (NBSS)
cadastrals_goa.description: Survey-number land parcels across Goa from Goa Bhoomi (ICAR-NBSS&LUP), with district, taluka and panchayat.

cadastrals_delhi.label: Land parcels (khasras), Delhi (GSDL)
cadastrals_delhi.description: Khasra (survey-number) parcels in the revenue villages of Delhi from Geospatial Delhi Limited, with district, sub-division, village (and Census codes), khasra number, land use type (agriculture, abadi, forest, water bodies, transport, public) and patwari status. Digitised 2012 to 2013; built-up urban Delhi has few khasras.

fsi_recorded_forest_area.label: Recorded forest area (FSI)
fsi_recorded_forest_area.description: Recorded forest area: land recorded as forest in government records (reserved, protected and unclassed forests), as digitised by the Forest Survey of India, with reserved forest name, compartment, beat, range, division, circle, district and LGD codes. Covers more states than the forest beats layer (Rajasthan, Assam, Himachal Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh and the North East); Gujarat and Madhya Pradesh are less complete here. Legal status, not tree cover. Many name fields are blank in the source.

wbc1_water_bodies.label: Water Bodies (1st Census, 2017-18)
wbc1_water_bodies.description: Ponds, tanks, lakes, reservoirs and check dams from the 1st Census of Water Bodies (reference year 2017-18): one point per water body with its type, ownership, use, storage, water spread, encroachment and repair or revival schemes.

bhuvan_lineaments_50k.label: Lineaments 1:50k (Bhuvan 2005-06)
bhuvan_lineaments_50k.description: Geological and geomorphic lineaments mapped at 1:50,000 by NRSC in the 2005-06 national geomorphology mapping. Mizoram, Lakshadweep and some UTs are missing in the source.

bhuvan_gw_prospect_structures.label: Groundwater prospect structures (Bhuvan)
bhuvan_gw_prospect_structures.description: Faults, fractures, dykes and lineaments mapped on the groundwater prospect maps of the Rajiv Gandhi National Drinking Water Mission (NRSC, 1:50k). Columns vary by state in the source. The prospect zones themselves are not included (too large for one file).

slusi_priority_micro_watersheds.label: Priority micro-watersheds (SLUSI)
slusi_priority_micro_watersheds.description: Micro-watersheds ranked by the Soil and Land Use Survey of India for soil conservation (priority from very high to very low), with hydrologic unit code. Use with the SLUSI micro-watershed boundaries.

gsi_lithology_50k.label: Lithology 1:50k (GSI)
gsi_lithology_50k.description: Rock units mapped at 1:50,000 by the Geological Survey of India: lithology, age, supergroup, group, formation and stratigraphy, by toposheet.

bhuvan_geomorphology_50k.label: Geomorphology 1:50k (Bhuvan 2005-06)
bhuvan_geomorphology_50k.description: Landforms mapped at 1:50,000 by NRSC in the 2005-06 national geomorphology mapping, in three levels (origin, process, landform). Mizoram, Lakshadweep and some UTs are missing in the source.

bhuvan_gw_prospects.label: Groundwater prospect zones (Bhuvan)
bhuvan_gw_prospects.description: Hydrogeomorphological units mapped at 1:50,000 by NRSC for the Rajiv Gandhi National Drinking Water Mission: lithology, landform and groundwater prospects, by state. Columns vary by state in the source.

bhuvan_land_degradation_1516.label: Land degradation 1:50k (Bhuvan 2015-16)
bhuvan_land_degradation_1516.description: Degraded land mapped at 1:50,000 by NRSC from 2015-16 satellite imagery: the process (water or wind erosion, salinity, waterlogging, mining and more) and its severity, with the 2005-06 mapping alongside.

urban_rail_stations.label: Metro and RRTS stations
urban_rail_stations.description: Stations in operation on India's metro and regional rapid transit (Namo Bharat) systems, one point per station, with its system, city and the lines that stop there.

urban_rail_lines.label: Metro and RRTS lines
urban_rail_lines.description: Lines in operation on India's metro and regional rapid transit systems, one feature per line with its name, number and colour where OpenStreetMap has them.

bus_stops.label: Bus stops
bus_stops.description: City bus stops from the open bus feeds of Bengaluru, Pune, the Mumbai region, Ahmedabad and Chennai, and from OpenStreetMap for Delhi, Kolkata, Kochi and Hyderabad, each row with its city, operator, source and licence.

airport.label: Airports, airfields and heliports
airport.description: Airports, airfields and heliports across India from OurAirports: IATA and ICAO codes, type, scheduled service, and the LGD state and district.

gsi_drilling_boreholes.label: Mineral exploration boreholes (GSI)
gsi_drilling_boreholes.description: Boreholes drilled in mineral exploration, with commodity, stage of investigation, depth, inclination, collar level, prospect, block and dates, from the Geological Survey of India.

gsi_hydrocarbon_blocks.label: Oil and gas blocks (NGDR)
gsi_hydrocarbon_blocks.description: Oil and gas blocks and fields, onland and offshore: nomination, PSC, HELP and OALP, discovered small field and coal bed methane blocks and producing fields, with basin, operator and status, from Directorate General of Hydrocarbons data in the National Geoscience Data Repository. Name columns differ by block type.

gsi_mineral_deposits.label: Mineral deposits (GSI)
gsi_mineral_deposits.description: Mineral deposits of every commodity (copper, iron, bauxite, gold, lead-zinc, manganese, chromite, diamond and more) with metallogenic belt, reserve, grade, host rock and formation, from the Geological Survey of India.

gsi_geothermal_springs.label: Geothermal springs (GSI)
gsi_geothermal_springs.description: Hot and thermal springs with temperature, pH, dissolved salts, mass flow and spring type, from the Geological Survey of India.

subsidence_point.label: Land subsidence, five megacities (InSAR)
subsidence_point.description: Land subsidence in Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Chennai and Kolkata: InSAR vertical land motion points in cm/yr (negative values mean the ground is sinking), from Ohenhen et al. 2025.

atal_bhujal_wells.label: Groundwater levels, Atal Bhujal wells (2015-2022)
atal_bhujal_wells.description: Groundwater levels in about 5,500 Atal Bhujal Yojana monitoring wells in seven States, before and after each monsoon from 2015 to 2022, in metres below ground level, with well depth and aquifer.

core_mws_water_balance.label: Water balance by micro-watershed (CoRE Stack, 2017-2025)
core_mws_water_balance.description: Yearly water balance for each micro-watershed CoRE Stack has mapped, 2017-18 to 2024-25: rainfall, runoff, evapotranspiration, the change in groundwater and the estimated change in depth to water, with net change over 5-year windows.

core_mws_drought.label: Drought by micro-watershed (CoRE Stack, 2017-2024)
core_mws_drought.description: Drought weeks for each micro-watershed CoRE Stack has mapped, each monsoon from 2017 to 2022 or 2024: weeks in mild, moderate and severe drought, dry spells, monsoon onset, kharif sown area and weekly rainfall deviation.

primary.name: Indian Railways (CRIS), via PM GatiShakti and the IR GIS portal; Wikidata

layers.notes: Merged by bharatlas and published under CC BY 4.0 (credit: bharatlas, Indian Railways / CRIS, PM GatiShakti, Wikidata). Sources: (1) PM GatiShakti railway stations (BISAG-N), drawn from CRIS's Indian Railways station layer; (2) the Indian Railways GIS portal stations (irgeoportal.gov.in, CRIS), the ir_stations layer; both compiled by ramSeraph/indianopenmaps (DataMeet community, CC0 1.0) and republished with credit under bharatlas.com/about#sources-and-licensing; (3) Wikidata items with an Indian Railways station code (P5696), CC0 1.0. Every location comes from CRIS. CRIS records most stations as several points (start, centre, end, platforms); points sharing a station code become one row at their medoid, and uncoded points within 1 km fold into it (source_points counts them, source_spread_m is how far they spread). Points of one code more than 2 km apart are treated as different stations. GatiShakti is used first; the IR portal adds the 52 codes GatiShakti lacks. A Wikidata code missing from CRIS is placed on the nearest CRIS station within 1.5 km whose name or description agrees (match_method name+distance; this also links CRIS's older codes to the current ones, e.g. CSTM/CSMT, BCT/MMCT, HNZM/NZM, KEU/KIUL: stn_code keeps CRIS's code, code holds Wikidata's), or on an uncoded CRIS point within 500 m on distance alone (distance). match_confidence: high = CRIS code and Wikidata agree within 1 km; medium = CRIS code not in Wikidata or 1 to 2 km away, or a name-confirmed match; low = Wikidata more than 2 km away, a distance-only match, or an uncoded CRIS point (stn_code empty). Checked against OpenStreetMap: high rows sit a median 26 m from OSM's station with the same code (98% within 500 m), medium 90%, low 87%. OpenStreetMap is used only for that check and is not merged, because its ODbL licence would require the whole layer to stay under ODbL. Every source column is kept as published (sttncode, sttnname, fdetail ... from CRIS; item, code, coord, label from Wikidata; coord is Wikidata's point, kept for reference, never the location), except the CRIS GIS accounts that created and last edited each point (created_us, last_edite), left out because some are individuals' usernames. Known gaps: about 800 Wikidata codes have no CRIS point to sit on and are left out (e.g. Kalyan KYN, whose only CRIS point is coded THK, and Lokmanya Tilak Terminus LTT); Wikidata positions are mostly copied from the 2016 datameet/railways compilation and sit a median ~90 m and a 90th percentile ~1.2 km from CRIS, so they are not used as locations. About 300 rows are uncoded, unnamed CRIS points. CRIS state names are as published (mixed case, some blank). Map tiles rebaked by bharatlas with the popup fields only; every column is in the parquet and the downloads.

layers.notes: Each year column (2017_2018 to 2024_2025, July to June) holds a JSON string with Precipitation, RunOff, ET, DeltaG and G in mm and WellDepth in metres: the water balance is rainfall minus runoff minus evapotranspiration, and WellDepth turns it into a change in depth to water using the aquifer's specific yield (weighted_avg_yeild, spelled as published; some tehsil files name it weighted_a, and a few add their own STATE, District and TEHSIL columns, all kept as published). Net2017_22 to Net2020_25 are the net change in depth to water in metres over each 5-year window; where the aquifer's yield is near zero they run very large (about 110 beyond 1,000 m), as published. CoRE Stack notes this counts only vertical flow, not water moving underground between micro-watersheds. Rainfall is from JAXA GSMaP, evapotranspiration from the FLDAS Noah land surface model (NASA, USGS). CoRE Stack computes this layer itself and publishes it per tehsil on its GeoServer, listed in its tehsil-wise STAC files, under CC-BY-4.0. bharatlas puts every tehsil file together as published: one row per micro-watershed per tehsil file, every column as published, with stac_state, stac_district and stac_tehsil added from the STAC path (CoRE Stack's spelling). A micro-watershed that crosses a tehsil boundary is in each tehsil's file, so the same uid can appear more than once, with values CoRE Stack computed for that tehsil. CoRE Stack covers the tehsils it has computed so far, not all of India. Methods: CoRE Stack's technical manual and code (github.com/core-stack-org).
